purpose: Stage-oriented lightweight index for LLM strategy selection. Unlike the old flat index, this index restricts strategy selection by stage and subphase order. Micro-strategies only provide local OptIR fields. Stage-level verification runs after the stage is complete.
global_selection_rules: The LLM must first follow current_stage and current_subphase.
Only select strategy_id values from the current subphase allowed_strategy_ids.
Do not run full post verification after a micro-strategy unless the stage is complete.
Micro-strategy local checks only verify provided fields.
Stage-level checks verify derived fields, resource limits, mapping consistency, runtime safety, and dynamic correctness.
Patch generation should be stage-level when the stage plan is complete, unless the implementation explicitly supports safe subphase patches.

Tiling.description: Construct BM/BN/BK, WM/WN, TM/TN, WMITER/WNITER, and mapping fields before running tiling verification.

subphases.purpose: Choose CTA/block tile shape BM/BN/BK.
selection_rules: Select at most one strategy_id for this subphase unless the subphase explicitly allows multiple.
Do not select a strategy outside allowed_strategy_ids.
Do not generate code during strategy selection.
For problem.size_class = large_square, prefer 128x128 CTA tiles with BK 16 or 32 when resource checks permit.

subphases.purpose: Choose warp-level tile shape WM/WN inside CTA tile.
selection_rules: Select at most one strategy_id for this subphase unless the subphase explicitly allows multiple.
Do not select a strategy outside allowed_strategy_ids.
Do not generate code during strategy selection.

subphases.purpose: Choose per-thread output tile TM/TN and optional WMITER/WNITER.
local_checks: if WMITER/WNITER are absent, default them to 1
selection_rules: Select one Tiling.ThreadTile.* strategy.
Optionally select one Tiling.WarpTile.Iteration.* strategy.
Do not change BM/BN/BK in this subphase.

subphases.purpose: Derive warp/thread/lane/output ownership after block, warp, and thread tile fields are complete.
selection_rules: Select Mapping.Warp.BasicWidLane or equivalent before WarpLaneFragment2D mapping.
Select at most one lane layout strategy.
Mapping strategies derive ownership; they should not change tile shapes.
